rows.note: This is the all-purpose job-related choice for quitting a job or orally announcing that you are leaving.

example.english: I have formally submitted my resignation and will stop working at the end of the month.
example.traditional: 我已經正式辭職，月底就唔做喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zing3 sik1 ci4 zik1 jyut6 dai2 zau6 m4 zou6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for accepting an undesirable outcome as unavoidable rather than for leaving a job.

example.english: I can only accept this outcome with resignation.
example.traditional: 見到咁嘅結果，我都唯有認命。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 gam3 ge3 git3 gwo2 ngo5 dou1 wai4 jau5 jing6 ming6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the resignation is a written letter or notice.

example.english: I have already put my resignation letter on the manager's desk.
example.traditional: 辭職信我已經放咗喺經理枱面。
example.jyutping: ci4 zik1 seon3 ngo5 ji5 ging1 fong3 zo2 hai2 ging1 lei5 ci4 min6
